# Aurelia

> A private, local-first personal finance and portfolio tracker. Track stocks, ETFs, crypto, precious metals, cash, custom assets, income, expenses, budgets, savings goals, credit-card debt and loans, all encrypted on your own device. No account, no cloud sync, no telemetry. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0). Web app plus native builds for Linux and Android today; Windows, macOS and iOS coming soon.

## What makes it different

- **Local-first & encrypted**: All data stays on your device with AES-GCM encryption. Nothing is uploaded, synced or shared.
- **Unified net worth**: Holdings (stocks, ETFs, crypto, metals, custom) plus liquidity (cash, cards) in one view, in your display currency.
- **Live market data**: Prices via Finnhub or public sources, with local price-history caching.
- **Cashflow Sankey**: Income, expenses, savings, investments and transfers in a customizable Sankey diagram.
- **Planning suite**: Monthly budgets, savings goals, 24-month forecast and loan amortization.
- **Multi-currency & i18n**: Six languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Dutch, Valencià) and every ISO currency.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with overview, features, comparison, FAQ and downloads.
- [Dashboard](/dashboard): Net worth, allocation, portfolio value and quick actions.
- [Holdings](/holdings): Stocks, ETFs, crypto, metals and custom assets with buy/sell history.
- [Performance](/performance): Time-weighted returns and historical charts.
- [Cashflow](/cashflow): Income, expenses, categories, credit cards, recurring items and Sankey.
- [Planning](/planning): Budgets, savings goals, forecast and loans.
